about: Trail is a city in British Columbia’s West Kootenay, on the Columbia River below the smelter benches, south of Castlegar and beside Rossland—not a hiking path, and not Trail, Nova Scotia. A Teck metallurgical-operations town with a river downtown and a “Home of Champions” sports tradition, it is the industrial heart of the Trail-Rossland area. About 8,000 people live in Trail.
